content:
Apple counts must be \(2k, 4k, 3k\) for some positive integer \(k\).  
But only \(3\) red apples are available, so \(4k \le 3\), which gives \(k \le \frac34\).  
No positive integer \(k\) satisfies this.

Therefore, the platter cannot be made.

\[
\boxed{\text{No such platter is possible}}
\]
